COVID-19 cases, deaths and vaccination during the Delta period

covid_delta.Rd

A cleaned subset of the Our World in Data COVID-19 dataset covering 1 June 2021 to 31 January 2022, when the Delta variant was dominant in most countries. Aggregates such as "World" and "Europe" are removed, and vaccination coverage is carried forward between reporting days.

Usage

covid_delta

Format

A tibble with 57,575 rows and 9 variables:

iso_code

Three-letter ISO 3166-1 country code.

continent

Continent of the country.

country

Country name.

date

Date of observation.

population

Population of the country.

new_cases_per_million

New confirmed cases per million people (7-day smoothed average).

new_deaths_per_million

New confirmed deaths per million people (7-day smoothed average).

fully_vaccinated_pct

People fully vaccinated per 100 people.

stringency_index

Government response stringency index (0 to 100, higher means stricter).

Source

Mathieu, E., Ritchie, H., et al. (2020). COVID-19 Dataset by Our World in Data. https://github.com/owid/covid-19-data. Licensed under CC BY. The source repository stopped updating on 19 August 2024.
